Available recipes:
    default                                 # Show available recipes

    [build]
    build                                   # Full build: frontend + backend
    build-all                               # Build for all platforms
    build-backend                           # Build the Rust backend
    build-darwin                            # Build for darwin (requires `rustup target add x86_64-apple-darwin` and a cross linker)
    build-domain-wasm                       # Build the domain WASM bindings into frontend/packages/domain-wasm/pkg
    build-frontend                          # Build frontend (pnpm)
    build-keycloak-theme                    # Build the Keycloak login theme (jar + exploded theme dir)
    build-linux                             # Build for linux (musl static binary; requires `rustup target add x86_64-unknown-linux-musl`)
    build-windows                           # Build for windows (requires `rustup target add x86_64-pc-windows-gnu` and mingw-w64)
    handbook-pdf                            # Render the user handbook PDF
    keycloak-theme-dev                      # Run the Keycloak theme dev server with mocked Keycloak context

    [check]
    bench                                   # Run the domain micro-benchmarks and record measurements
    bench-check                             # Execute every benchmark once without measuring; this is what CI runs
    # Grow through every scale and measure after each
    bench-db-campaign out="target/bench/campaign" history="730"
    bench-db-run out="target/bench/manual"  # Measure the read paths against an already seeded benchmark database
    bench-db-seed scale="s" history="730"   # Seed a dedicated benchmark database to one scale (xs|s|m|l)
    docs                                    # Build and open the Rust API docs in the browser (includes the logging field convention from telemetry.rs)
    lint                                    # Lint Rust + frontend
    test                                    # Run Rust + frontend tests
    test-clean                              # Remove testcontainer leftovers; only a hard kill (SIGKILL) can leave any behind
    test-verbose                            # Run Rust tests with verbose output
    tidy                                    # Format Rust code

    [codegen]
    dump-openapi                            # Dump the OpenAPI spec from the Rust backend into the frontend client package
    generate                                # Run all code generation (backend + frontend)
    generate-backend                        # Run all backend code generation (sqlx prepare)
    generate-frontend                       # Run frontend code generation (refreshes api-docs.json from Rust backend, then runs pnpm generate:local)
    generate-sqlx                           # Refresh sqlx offline query cache (.sqlx/) — requires running DB and sqlx-cli

    [db]
    import-kataster-fl *ARGS                # Requires KATASTER_SOURCE_URL. Pass flags via ARGS, e.g. `just import-kataster-fl --dry-run`.
    import-staging file="staging.sql" *ARGS # Destructive: drops schema public. Pass --yes to skip the prompt.
    migrate-new name                        # Create a new migration file (requires sqlx-cli for scaffolding)
    migrate-reset                           # Drop and recreate the database, then migrate
    migrate-status                          # Show migration status
    migrate-up                              # Apply all pending migrations
    seed-down                               # Remove all seed data (runs *.down.sql files in reverse order)
    seed-reset                              # Reset DB, migrate, then apply seeds
    seed-up                                 # Apply seeds on top of the current DB (assumes empty/migrated schema)

    [infra]
    dns-cleanup                             # Remove Porkbun DNS records
    dns-setup                               # Create Porkbun DNS records for local dev
    infra-down                              # Stop all compose services and delete volumes
    infra-stop                              # Stop all compose services (infra, app and plugins)
    infra-up                                # Start infrastructure services
    plugin-demo-down                        # Stop and remove the demo plugin
    plugin-demo-up                          # Start the demo plugin used for the manual plugin integration test
    valhalla-tiles                          # (Re)build patched Valhalla tiles from scratch (CONSTRUCTION=1 for TBZ roadworks)

    [run]
    frontend-dev                            # Run frontend dev server [alias: fe-dev]
=== compose services ===
2:  keycloak:
68:  keycloak-init-db:
86:  db:
102:  pgadmin:
163:  streamlet:
185:  valhalla:
217:  reverse-proxy:
240:  backend:
241:    profiles: ["app"]
290:  frontend:
291:    profiles: ["app"]
323:  migrations:
324:    profiles: ["app"]
348:  demo-plugin:
351:    profiles: ["plugins"]
381:  db_data:

observation.command: cd /workspace && just --list 2>/dev/null | head -60; echo "=== compose services ==="; grep -n "^  [a-z].*:\|profiles:" compose.yaml | head -50
